## GOV-P0-01 draft control extension

Candidate mandatory evidence fields:

- evidence status/classification, work-item and session IDs;
- maker, checker and explicit independence assertion;
- worktree, branch, exact source commit and tree hashes;
- environment and tool versions;
- commands, exit codes and captured artifact hashes;
- mandatory tests, skips and approved exceptions;
- clean-room and security declarations;
- checker verdict, separate authority decision and residual risks.
